overall: The AG found the Brookline Advisory Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to periodically review executive session minutes, declined to find the violation intentional, and ordered no further relief because the Committee had already reviewed all outstanding minutes and committed to twice-annual reviews.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to conduct periodic review of its executive session minutes to determine whether continued nondisclosure was warranted.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Committee has conceded that it failed to review its executive session minutes at reasonable intervals.

allegations.summary: Complainant urged that the periodic-review violation was intentional; the AG considered whether it was knowing under the intentional-violation standard.
allegations.key_passage: Since it was not the same public body which previously violated the open meeting law, we decline to find this violation intentional.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
